description: This class 'DepositAccountDataValidator' provides validation logic for deposit account data submissions and updates within a financial application, particularly for fixed and recurring deposit accounts. It performs detailed JSON schema validation, including required fields, value ranges, and consistency checks, ensuring deposit account data integrity before processing.

classes.name: DepositAccountDataValidator
classes.description: A validator class for deposit account data submissions and updates, including fixed and recurring deposits. It incorporates detailed validation methods that check JSON payload accuracy, required fields, field constraints, and inter-field consistency.

methods.name: validateFixedDepositForSubmit
methods.description: Validates the deposit data for submission when creating a fixed deposit account. Checks for unsupported parameters, required fields, and value constraints for deposit details, pre-closure, deposit terms, charges, and tax settings.

methods.name: validateFixedDepositForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the deposit data for updating an existing fixed deposit account, similar to the submit validation but tailored for updates, including optional fields.

methods.name: validateRecurringDepositForSubmit
methods.description: Validates the data for submitting a new recurring deposit account, including deposit details, pre-closure, deposit terms, recurring parameters, charges, and tax.

methods.name: validateRecurringDepositForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the data for updating an existing recurring deposit account, similar to the submit but with optional parameters.

methods.name: validateFixedDepositForInterestCalculation
methods.description: Validates the request JSON for interest calculation on a fixed deposit, ensuring required interest calculation parameters are valid.

methods.name: validatelinkedSavingsAccount
methods.description: Validates the linked savings account against certain conditions such as active status and client association.

methods.name: throwLinkedAccountRequiredError
methods.description: Throws a validation exception indicating that a linked savings account is required.
